$comment: Curated font sets. A set supplies the actual font stacks for the theme's three fixed family slugs (sans / serif / mono). The slugs never change — post content references them as has-sans-font-family — so switching set restyles the whole site without touching a single block. Phase 4 adds self-hosted sets with fontFace declarations pointing at assets/fonts/; these first three are OS stacks and ship no files.
